text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute won the Tokyo Daishoten. 
Showing her seasoned dignity to Hokko 
Tarumae, she smiled gently, telling her to 
come catch up.

The path of dirt racing is endlessly long. 
Even so, Wonder Acute vows to keep moving 
forward as long as life remains in her.

To keep shining and showing hope to 
everyone—next year, and the year after 
that, her story will not end.
